metadata.title: fix(auth): set teams=None instead of [] for All Teams API tokens
metadata.author: crivetimihai

description:
## Summary
- Admin API tokens created with "All Teams" scope got `teams=[]` (public-only) instead of `teams=null`, causing all `/admin/*` endpoints to return 403 even for `is_admin=true` users.
- Changed `token_catalog_service.py:273` from `teams = [team_id] if team_id else []` to `teams = [team_id] if team_id else None`, so that `normalize_token_teams()` correctly grants admin bypass when `is_admin=true`.
- Added regression test `test_generate_token_no_team_sets_teams_none`.

Closes #3654

## Test plan
- [x] New regression test verifies `teams is None` when no `team_id` is provided
- [x] All 132 token catalog service tests pass
- [x] All 20 token scoping tests pass

reviews.author: marekdano
reviews.body:
Excellent Fix

Summary:
The PR correctly fixes issue #3654 where admin API tokens created with "All Teams" scope were incorrectly assigned `teams=[]` (public-only) instead of `teams=None` (admin bypass), causing 403 errors on /admin/* endpoints even for `is_admin=true` users.

Verification Results:
    - ✅ New regression test passes
    - ✅ All 132 token catalog service tests pass
    - ✅ All 20 token scoping tests pass
    - ✅ Fix aligns with normalize_token_teams() truth table in auth.py

Security Analysis:
The fix correctly implements the two-layer security model:
    - teams: null + is_admin: true → None (admin bypass - sees all teams) ✓
    - teams: null + is_admin: false → [] (public-only - no bypass) ✓
    - teams: [] → [] (explicit public-only) ✓

Code Quality:
    - Minimal, surgical change (one line + comment)
    - Well-documented with clear intent
    - Follows existing patterns and conventions
    - No breaking changes to existing functionality

LGTM 🚀

commits.message:
fix(ui): update token scope labels to reflect admin bypass for all-teams tokens

The backend fix changed no-team tokens from teams=[] (public-only) to
teams=null (admin bypass when is_admin=true). The admin UI still labeled
these tokens as "public-only" in 6 places, which is now incorrect for
admin users. Update all labels and the scope warning to accurately
describe the behavior: admin users retain full access, non-admin users
see public resources only.

Closes #3654

Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>
